messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — after the 12:15 docs deploy a bunch of runbook images are 403. I ran a lightweight scan and found ~20 pages with missing assets. Sample: /kb/runbooks/oncall-playbook, /docs/runtime/caching, /kb/kv-cache/faq

defploy-bot: docs-deploy v2.7 finished at 12:15 UTC :white_check_mark:

CJ: which images are 403 vs 404? can you paste a sample URL or grep?

Maya: Mostly CDN 403s from old shortlinks. grep I used:
```
rg "GET .* 403" -g "**/public/*" --hidden | cut -d' ' -f2 | uniq | head
```
This returns urls like https://cdn.internal.redwood/snapshots/runbook-123.png

Rohit: I can pick this up. do we want to rehost under /assets/docs/ and update mdx links? quick PR ok?

Maya: yes please. prefer rehost + update shortlink->full path. Also add an entry in the patch notes doc so search wont show dead links.

Ava: quick ask — can we also add a CODEOWNERS entry for /kb/* so next time the right team gets pinged? small follow-up PR ok.

Rohit: working on a tiny PR now. will add CODEOWNERS change and a sed script to rewrite shortlinks.

Rohit: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12378
Diff snippet:
```
-![](https://cdn.internal.redwood/snapshots/runbook-123.png)
+![](/assets/docs/runbook-123.png)
```

CJ: :thumbsup: ping @eng-platform if you need a CDN invalidation or redirect in front of the shortlink domain.

Maya: thanks. I'll add a quick test step to our docs CI to fail on 403 image asserts (non-blocking for now).

Rohit: PR opened, added test + sed script + CODEOWNERS change. requesting review from @Maya and @Ava

Ava: reviewing now, expect tiny comments. thanks for grabbing it :heart:

Maya: LGTM pending one nit. I'll approve after.

Rohit: thanks all — will merge once approved and watch the smoke tests. :eyes:

defploy-bot: smoke-check: images-test passed in CI (12:42 UTC) :white_check_mark:

Maya: Nice. I'll sweep the link scanner again tomorrow morning and re-run the crawl. If anything else pops up I'll open a follow-up thread.
